transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in today because... I just can't shake this absolute certainty that I'm being punished. It's because I let my father decline. My sister tries to tell me I'm wrong, and she even shows me his doctor's notes to prove I did everything right. But... it doesn't really matter what she says or shows me. It just feels like some kind of judgment has already been passed on me, and I don't know how to live with it.
Alongside this belief, have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I have. Most days I just... I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the color has completely gone out of everything. I can sit at my desk in HR, or... or just stare at the garden beds at home, and it feels like none of it really reaches me anymore. It just stays like that all day.
Have there been times when you held this belief even though you were not feeling depressed?

No, I haven't. I never... I never heard voices or believed I was being punished before this depression really settled in. It all kind of revolves around my father's decline, but those specific experiences—the punishment, the voices—they only started after I had already spent months feeling low, guilty, and just completely worn down. So, no, I've never had those thoughts without feeling this way first.
Before this current period of depression, had you ever experienced another period when you were depressed in a similar way?

No, I haven't. I mean... I've had stressful times before, just with life and work, but never a period where I felt depressed like this. This is really the first time I've ever felt this low, or had it last this long.
